threat_event: Intruder gains administrator access to the IBOP and changes doors, schedules, and setpoints at many customer buildings, and exports cardholder data
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist group; state-sponsored actor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy remote tools at 37 acquired sites; standing cross-tenant global administrator role; OT logging at 61% of sites
regulatory_driver: State contract exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); C-GOVERNMENT-R08; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (Florida worked example)
existing_controls: PAM jump service at 259 sites; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Retire legacy remote access; per-customer just-in-time administration; OT log onboarding; cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services into the IBOP and division systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network, and platform connect all divisions; unsupported workstations at county sites; flat networks at 19 sites
regulatory_driver: Customer contract notice terms; SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: EDR; immutable backups in provider B; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Segment flat sites; replace unsupported workstations; quarterly restore tests including the monitoring module

threat_event: A shared incident triggers notices under hundreds of contracts, GSA, DoD, state law, and the SEC, and one is missed or late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract notice terms inventoried for 71% of contracts; matrix never exercised across divisions; no CUI steps in group playbooks
regulatory_driver: Customer contract notice terms; GSA BTTRG v3.0 section 1.6.1; N23-R03 (DFARS 252.204-7012(c)); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: Group notification matrix (2025); SOC case management
treatment_plan: Complete the contract inventory; revise the matrix and plan; cross-division tabletop with customers

threat_event: AI used in physical security, building control, and hiring causes unfair, unsafe, or unlawful outcomes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI Standard adopted after face verification and video analytics went live; no bias audit of applicant screening; closed-loop HVAC pilot
regulatory_driver: Colorado SB26-189 (from 2027-01-01); Fla. Stat. 501.171 and 501.702 (Florida worked example); FTC Act Section 5
existing_controls: Group AI council and standard (2026-03); human fallback at face readers
treatment_plan: Group AI program conditions (P10): consent, retention, bias testing, vendor terms, bounded control writes

threat_event: Covered defense information is mishandled in Construction and IBOP systems, and the group loses DoD award eligibility
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI in commercial SaaS and the commissioning workspace; SPRS score 71 of 110; 7012 flow-down in 9 of 24 sampled subcontracts
existing_controls: CUI enclave (40% migrated); CMMC Level 1 affirmation
treatment_plan: Finish enclave migration; block CUI elsewhere; raise SPRS score above 88; C3PAO assessment before DoD bids

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment is found in use, putting federal contracts at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Installation business not screened; 4 NVRs at the central monitoring station with unconfirmed manufacturer
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G5 monitoring module; SYS-J3; federal contracts
existing_controls: Group screening for Facilities Support and Construction purchases (2025)
treatment_plan: Confirm the 4 NVRs; extend screening and the approved manufacturer list to the installation business; report within 1 business day if covered

threat_event: Privileged or integrator accounts are taken over by phishing or token theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 integrator accounts without MFA; integrator accounts outside identity governance; default device passwords at acquired sites
regulatory_driver: State contract exhibit (SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate); FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(vi)
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM
treatment_plan: Integrator accounts in identity governance with MFA; vault all device credentials

threat_event: The access control SaaS vendor suffers an outage or breach affecting all 188 access control sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor for all access control tenants
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 review; controllers cache credentials 72 hours
treatment_plan: Contract terms for notice and recovery; cyber insurance; local lockdown procedures

threat_event: Loss of ROC-2 (hurricane or facility failure) halts monitoring for two divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monitoring module failover and ROC-2 to ROC-1 switchover never tested
existing_controls: ROC-1 absorbed Facilities Support alarms in the 2026-05 exercise
treatment_plan: Test monitoring failover; cross-train ROC-1 for the central monitoring station

threat_event: Workforce screening data is breached or misused, or former workers keep customer-site credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer reports open to about 310 users; no disposal schedule; customer-site credentials returned about 4 days after separation
regulatory_driver: N56-R01 (16 CFR 682.3); N56-R02 (15 U.S.C. 1681b(b)); N56-R03 (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (Florida worked example)
existing_controls: Background checks before assignment; E-Verify
treatment_plan: Role redesign for consumer reports; disposal schedule; same-day credential disablement at customer sites

threat_event: Division policy drift and undocumented inheritance hide control failures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Janitorial and Security on its 2022 policy set; Construction CMMC SSP lists no inherited controls
existing_controls: Group policies (2026); common control catalog
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Janitorial and Security supplement; inheritance matrices for both divisions

threat_event: OT intrusions or tampering go undetected for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT logs from 61% of sites; no OT-specific detections
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC for cloud, identity, and SaaS
treatment_plan: Onboard all sites; OT detections for setpoint and program changes

threat_event: An insider with cross-tenant administration misuses access control at customer buildings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing global administrator role for 41 people; administrators can approve their own role changes
existing_controls: Fingerprint-based screening; SaaS audit trail
treatment_plan: Per-customer just-in-time elevation; separation of creation and approval

threat_event: Security-sensitive building information is disclosed through public records responses or careless sharing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drawings and layouts shared with subcontractors and customers; custodian routing not always followed
existing_controls: Public records procedure; labeling of security drawings
treatment_plan: Exempt-record labeling; requests routed to customer custodians; training

threat_event: The group files a late or inaccurate disclosure about a material cybersecurity incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality inputs depend on the notification process (GR-03)
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cybersecurity
treatment_plan: Include the disclosure committee in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: A payroll or time-capture outage misses hourly wages for tens of thousands of workers
threat_source: System outage; ransomware at a vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single payroll SaaS; time capture in SYS-J1
regulatory_driver: State wage-payment laws (each state of operation)
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 review; prior-period rerun procedure
treatment_plan: Annual payroll outage exercise; pay card contingency

threat_event: A compromised software update from a building automation or access control vendor reaches many sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates pushed to many sites; supplier notification terms missing
existing_controls: Annual supplier reviews; staged rollouts
treatment_plan: Supplier notification terms at renewal; hash checks before rollout

threat_event: Workforce use of unapproved generative AI exposes CUI or customer security data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved-tools list new; estimating tool sent CUI to an AI service
existing_controls: POL-05 approved tools rule; web filtering of public AI sites
treatment_plan: Enterprise assistant with data rules; block uploads of labeled CUI

threat_event: New state contract security terms (GovRAMP) are not met by renewal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No GovRAMP plan
existing_controls: SOC 2 Type 1; SP 800-53 Moderate SSP
treatment_plan: GovRAMP readiness plan using the SSP and SOC 2 evidence

threat_event: A hurricane damages customer buildings and regional hubs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida and Gulf exposure; 26% of local sites without recovery procedures
regulatory_driver: GSA BTTRG v3.0 section 1.6.2; customer contracts
existing_controls: Storm plans; generators; satellite phones at 6 hubs
treatment_plan: Complete building recovery procedures; pre-season exercise
